cloud.failure_mode: Nothing breaks for local users: paired to any third-party coordinator the sensors never touch the Tuya cloud at all. In the stock configuration (sensor -> Tuya ZigBee gateway -> Smart Life app) a Tuya cloud outage or shutdown would kill app access, remote monitoring and automation for that gateway — the rescue is to re-pair the sensor to your own coordinator, which needs no cooperation from Tuya. The only stock-app features with no coordinator-side equivalent are the °C/°F default and alarm thresholds, and both are writable DPs documented in this spec.
cloud.notes: No cloud hosts are documented here on purpose: the device itself has no IP stack and no cloud dependency. Whatever the Tuya gateway talks to is the gateway's cloud surface, not this device's.
cloud.vendor_service: Tuya Smart / Smart Life cloud (optional; only in the loop when the sensor is paired to a Tuya ZigBee gateway)

identification.notes: Retail box labels (ZG-303Z, HZ-SL04, QT-07S, GXM-01, GX04, GX06, CS-201Z, AY-302Z/303Z) are rebadge names and must NOT be used to pick a DP map: "ZG-303Z" in particular appears as the zigbeeModel of at least two devices with different DP layouts. Key everything off manufacturerName.

device.manufacturer: Tuya-based white-label OEMs (GIEX, Qoto, HOBEIAN, COOLO, AOYAN, Haozee and others)
device.name: Generic ZigBee Soil Tester (Tuya TS0601 family)
device.notes: Battery-powered (2xAA) sleepy ZigBee 3.0 end devices with a soil probe: they wake on their sampling interval, report soil moisture and soil temperature as Tuya datapoints on cluster 0xEF00, and go back to sleep. Richer variants add ambient air temperature/humidity, a light sensor, alarm thresholds, calibration offsets and configurable sampling intervals — all as extra datapoints, never as standard ZCL clusters. The Tuya/Smart Life app only enters the picture when the sensor is paired to a Tuya ZigBee gateway; for local control with any third-party coordinator (Zigbee2MQTT reference implementation; ZHA partial via quirks) the vendor stack is irrelevant.

issued_to_client: IEEE address and network address, assigned by the coordinator at join
credentials.notes: No WiFi exists on the device and no user credential of any kind crosses a documented link; the only secret is the ZigBee network key delivered by the coordinator during the standard join handshake.
stored_on_device: ZigBee network membership: PAN ID, extended PAN ID, channel and the network key, assigned at join

factory_reset.effect: No factory reset distinct from the ZigBee leave/rejoin procedure is documented for any variant. Holding the button (~5-6 s, the same gesture used for pairing) makes the device leave its network and re-enter join mode, which is the only reset a sleepy ZigBee end device of this kind exposes: it clears the network binding (PAN ID / network key), nothing else. Whether on-device calibration offsets and alarm thresholds survive is unverified — assume they persist and re-check the writable DPs after rejoining.

procedures.indicator: LED flashes; the coordinator logs a leave/join event.
procedures.name: Leave network / re-enter pairing (button hold)

steps.action: Hold the device button ~5-6 s until the LED flashes (same procedure as initial pairing).
Remove the stale device entry in the old coordinator if it does not clean up on its own.

methods.description: Standard ZigBee 3.0 join to any coordinator (ConBee, SONOFF ZBDongle, CC2652-based sticks, etc.) under Zigbee2MQTT or ZHA. No Tuya gateway, account or cloud involvement at any point.

steps.action: Put the coordinator into permit-join mode.
Hold the sensor's button for ~5-6 s until the LED flashes.
steps.expect: Coordinator reports a new device; interview reads modelIdentifier TS0601 and the manufacturerName fingerprint.

steps.action: Match the reported manufacturerName against the fingerprint groups in this spec to select the DP map — do not trust the retail model string.

causes: Device went back to sleep mid-interview — keep it awake with short button presses until the interview finishes.
Stock ZHA has no quirk for this fingerprint yet (several only landed via 2025 community requests); Zigbee2MQTT supports all groups in this spec natively, or use a custom quirk/converter.
troubleshooting.symptom: Interview times out or device shows as unsupported/unknown.

causes: Known quirk (z2m issue #31965): force a re-interview / reconfigure of the device in the coordinator.
troubleshooting.symptom: After a battery swap the device reports stale 0 values.

causes: Known firmware quirk on some units (z2m issue #31965): they report in °F regardless of the temperature-unit DP; decode accordingly or convert client-side.
troubleshooting.symptom: Temperature reports look like °F even though the unit DP says °C.

setup.notes: There is no vendor provisioning flow to reproduce: onboarding IS standard ZigBee 3.0 joining. Put any coordinator into permit-join and hold the device's button ~5-6 s until its LED flashes; the device joins, is interviewed, and starts reporting. Confidence medium: the button procedure is stated on the Zigbee2MQTT device pages and in vendor manuals, not replayed here. Keep the device awake (button presses) if the interview stalls — these are hard sleepers.

rejoin.notes: Moving to a new coordinator is the standard ZigBee leave-then-join above; no cloud account is involved on either side. The old coordinator does not need to be alive — the leave is initiated on the device.

testing.notes: Nothing here was replayed against hardware by this project. Every DP map and fingerprint below is transcribed from a 2026-08-19 snapshot of Koenkk/zigbee-herdsman-converters src/devices/tuya.ts (sha256 in sources), cross-checked against the Zigbee2MQTT device pages. There is no vendor app protocol to reverse: these are pure ZigBee end devices, and no APK was acquired because none is needed for local control.

dp_frame.description: Tuya datapoint framing on cluster 0xEF00. Each cluster command payload carries a transaction sequence number followed by one or more datapoint records. A record is: [dpid u8][type u8][length u16 big-endian][value, length bytes]. Type codes: 0x00 raw, 0x01 bool, 0x02 value (u32 big-endian, the carrier for all scaled integers below), 0x03 string, 0x04 enum, 0x05 bitmap. The coordinator-to- device direction (set/command) and the device-to-coordinator direction (report/response) use the same record layout under the Tuya cluster's data-request / data-report / data-response command IDs. Value semantics (which dpid means what, and its scaling) are per fingerprint group in dp_maps below.

datapoints.name: soil_temperature
datapoints.notes: Raw °C on the classic group; the soil_2/soil_3 groups carry the same DP divided by 10 — check the fingerprint before decoding.

datapoints.name: temperature_unit
datapoints.notes: Settable display/report unit; some firmware reports °F regardless (see setup troubleshooting).

datapoints.name: battery
datapoints.notes: Known false-scaling quirk on some hardware — the raw value is used upstream; treat odd percentages with suspicion.

datapoints.name: brightness_level
datapoints.notes: Light sensor — GX06 (_TZE284_3urschql) only; absent on GX04 and _TZE284_aao3yzhs.

datapoints.name: soil_sampling_period (classic cs201z) / soil_fertility (4-in-1 spin)
datapoints.notes: A newer 4-in-1 variant of this family adds soil fertility: DP 112 fertility value, DP 114 fertility warning threshold, DP 115 fertility warning enum. Fingerprints for that spin sit near the _TZE284_* line of the converters snapshot and are not pinned down in this spec — treat as unverified.

input_clusters.name: Basic (carries modelIdentifier=TS0601 and the manufacturerName fingerprint)

zigbee.notes: There are no standard ZCL temperature or humidity measurement clusters on these devices: every sensor reading and every setting is a Tuya datapoint on cluster 0xEF00. A client that polls 0x0402/0x0405 gets nothing; subscribe to the Tuya cluster instead.
